record: Hong Kong Antiquities Advisory Board building appraisal 669
facts: The 1955 sanctuary used granite, concrete, rectangular side louvers and a pitched roof. The detached granite bell tower had a simple roof and bell void. The 1890 foundation stone was re-laid by the entrance stairs.
The final service in this building took place on 27 August 2017. The new building at the same address opened in September 2023.
Confirms the 1955 sanctuary as subsequently demolished.
